summary.name: Flat Vector Illustration is a supplemental design reference, not a directly named style in the source collection. Using SVG does not by itself establish this aesthetic.
summary.visualIdentity: Clear flat color fields, simplified figures and consistent corner radii, using three to five main colors with one fixed accent. Icons, outlines and typography stay proportionally consistent. Avoid photoreal reflections, complex materials and inconsistent shadows.
summary.suitableUses: Explicit: the style stands alone for most explainers and brand pieces. Inferred from catalog compatibility lists: kinetic phrases, punctuation zooms, logo bursts, word smash cuts and narrative or chaptered sequences. Not suited to photoreal or material-heavy scenes.
summary.limitations: Source verification is sampled only: palette from seconds 1–8, motion references from seconds 6–10 and 75–81. No continuous motion, audio, sub-second timing or easing was verified. Gaze motion requires eye layers or a rig. Punctuation zoom requires an actual mark, and logo burst requires an approved mark.
summary.palette: Background policy is scene_dependent: #F7F3E9 is an illustrative swatch, not a required canvas. Suggested tokens are foreground #243746, accent_1 #267D82, accent_2 #DD7353 (fixed coral emphasis) and accent_3 #EAC664, with no gradient. Foreground on background measures 11.083:1; accent_1 and accent_2 are decorative only. Task-supplied exact colors override all suggestions. Source examples are per-subject choices, not style requirements.
summary.motionAndInteraction: Optional motion references: bounded eye-following with delayed brows and blinks (motion-006); progress-linked chapter handoffs (motion-012); story-step scrollytelling (motion-015); phrase scatter, punctuation zoom, radial logo burst and word smash cuts (motion-037 to motion-040). Choose none if the scene assets do not support the action. Video timing derives from composition time; scroll and pointer apply only to interactive delivery. Preserve reading holds and avoid automatic glitch or spring effects.
summary.audio: Unspecified for this style; no genre, tempo, voice or mandatory layer is assigned. Choose audio from the topic and audience, and silence is valid. No beat synchronization is verified because the source review was visual-only. Use measured audio timing only when it has been inspected. Any speech must stay intelligible and must not compete with on-screen copy.
summary.assetRequirements: Use only task-supplied or locally created assets. Do not invent brand marks, product copy, photographs or real footage. Preserve approved mark geometry and exact copy. Gaze motion needs suitable eye layers or a rig, and punctuation or logo motions need the actual mark or glyph. Load local fonts before rendering. Source frames provide no verified exact hex values.
summary.combinations: Explicit: style-095 places UI screens inside flat devices, keeping #DD7353 as the CTA accent with no glass or realistic shadows. Style-097 adds flat charts with honest scales, primary tokens only, at most three series, and no gradients or 3D bars. Avoid photoreal device renders and invented data. Most explainers need no hybrid.
summary.productionApproach: Style renderer: native SVG primitives, groups, masks and clipPath, with PixiJS, tldraw, Paper.js or Cytoscape.js optional. Motion engine: a paused GSAP timeline as the core, with Motion, mo.js or Anime.js optional and one owner per animated property. Pipeline: HyperFrames by default, with Remotion only for a recorded fallback reason. Seed randomness, derive state from composition time, and verify forward, backward and direct seeks.
